scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm run render:build
scripts.render:build: PORT=19852 BASE_PATH=/ corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/whatsapp-platform run build && rm -rf artifacts/api-server/public && cp -R artifacts/whatsapp-platform/dist/public artifacts/api-server/public && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
